issue.title: Deploy generated shell-completion scripts through chezmoi on SASE-managed machines
issue.description:
Recorded as deliberately deferred by epic plan sase-oc (plan:202608/cli_completion.md, 'Deferred' section) and filed by that epic's land agent per the discovered-work rule. Also documented for users under docs/completion.md#deferred.

TODAY: 'sase completion install' writes the script on the machine it runs on and stamps ~/.sase/completion/stamp/<shell>.json. Nothing carries that script across SASE-managed hosts, so every new machine needs a manual install, and a script regenerated on one host never reaches the others.

SCOPE: deploy the generated scripts through src/sase/main/_init_chezmoi_deploy.py the way the other chezmoi-managed assets are, so a SASE-managed host gets a current _sase / sase / sase.fish from the dotfiles repo. Decide deliberately how this interacts with the local install path: the stamp, .zwc freshness (a chezmoi-delivered zsh script still needs zcompile on the target host), the doctor checks in src/sase/doctor/checks_completion.py, and the flagged 'sase update' refresh hook (feature flag completion_refresh_on_update, removal bead sase-om) must not fight each other over the same file.

CONSTRAINT: the chezmoi repo is a linked repo — open it with /sase_repo, never by path.
